scheduler_source_of_truth: live ChatGPT automation registry for this account
namespace_policy: Only the five automation IDs listed in active[] are authorized to write under omega_stack_native_v2. Any other writer is foreign and must be ignored/quarantined.
previous_namespace_policy: automation_intelligence/omega_stack is READ-ONLY historical/conflict evidence for this stack.

runtime_budget.rule: First tool call is a single append-only GitHub create_file liveness mutation. No read/search/analysis/plugin discovery may precede it.

reason: Isolated namespace created after verified concurrent foreign writes repeatedly overwrote the prior omega_stack scheduler identities and AION state.

scheduler_health_policy.rule: Scheduled lanes may not create, delete, enable, disable, reschedule, or rewrite sibling automations. Scheduler topology is externally managed; lanes only persist/read their own isolated repo state.

identity_binding.authority: live automation registry + isolated control plane

persistence_acceptance.immutable_history_source: Append-only Git files and their commits
persistence_acceptance.liveness_success: Natural run creates one unique immutable run receipt using GitHub create_file as its first tool call, with no prerequisite read.
persistence_acceptance.work_success: Same RUN_ID optionally creates a separate immutable <lane>/work/<RUN_ID>.json receipt after one bounded work call.
persistence_acceptance.acceptance_rule: A lane is scheduler/persistence healthy after two consecutive natural v4.3 immutable liveness receipts with distinct RUN_IDs.
persistence_acceptance.stack_target: All five lanes satisfy two consecutive natural v4.3 liveness receipts; report work-completion rate separately.

scheduler_jitter_policy.rule: Actual start within +/-6 minutes is tolerated transport jitter and does not invalidate the run; scheduled_for records the nominal slot.

last_manual_reconciliation.assessment: AION post-hardening v4.2 run persisted fresh liveness. DAEDALUS then triggered within allowed jitter but produced no new authoritative receipt, proving fetch+CAS still has a residual short-runtime failure mode.
last_manual_reconciliation.corrective_action: Migrate persistence from v4.2 two-call fetch+CAS to v4.3 one-call append-only create_file liveness receipts.
